test_save_file: test the save_file function to write TensorFlow tensors to a safetensors file
test_load_file: test the load_file function to read tensors from a safetensors file
test_safe_open: test the safe_open context manager to read tensors from a safetensors file with framework tf
test_bfloat16: test bfloat16 tensor serialization and deserialization with save_file and safe_open
test_zero_sized: test handling of zero-sized (empty) tensors during save and reload with save_file and load_file
